$comment: SendRequest: a bot asks the operator peer for a decision before pushing a fix. The first valid approval_response closes it; at expiry the hub posts an approval_response with decision "expired" (sender "hub"). Escalation (phase 2): if addressed to a non-operator and still open at the halfway point of the window, the hub forwards a copy to the operator with wake priority.
